Episode 1 of Eternal Bihar explores the historic forts of Bihar—silent sentinels that witnessed empires rise and fall. From strategic strongholds to royal bastions, these forts reveal stories of power, warfare, and architectural brilliance that shaped Bihar’s historical identity.
